tina: Opening a draft to add a clear example of a union-array + compact fallback for function/tool calling. will show canonical JSON and a one-line compact envelope. PR: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1301|#1301>.
jory: paste the schema and both outputs here so i can adapt the py sdk snippet.
tina: schema: object with field `steps` array where item is string OR object {name, opts}.
Canonical: { "steps": ["ping", {"name":"notify","opts":{"user":"a@x.com"}} ] }
Compact: {"s":["ping",{"n":"notify","o":{"u":"a@x.com"}}]}
pat: add note to prefer token-friendly keys (no spaces) and to set strip_outer_text=true in parser helper. we should also show parseWithFallback usage in both JS and Python.
docs-bot: PR created by tina: #1301 30 reviewers: @jory, @pat.
jory: I'll add minimal py snippet: parsed = parse_with_fallback(resp.text, schema, compact_fallback=True, strip_outer_text=True)
